purpose: Illustrated video posters only; actual kindergarten recordings play after user action.

prompts.text: Use case: illustration-story. Create one finished portrait 4:5 website video cover, not a mockup. Reference image is the approved Elbebi rabbit: preserve its long asymmetric ears, white fur, thin warm-gray contours, black cat-eye glasses, calm confident eyes, tiny pink nose and original proportions. No chibi, no oversized sparkling eyes, no new clothes. Elegant friendly kindergarten brand illustration, clean flat vector-like raster artwork with restrained soft shading on objects. Palette: warm ivory #fffdf7, pale mint #dceee3, pale pink #ffdde5, buttery yellow #fff0ce, small teal and purple #6d2194 accents. Lots of breathing room, an organic pastel color wash, a small leafy sprig, 2-3 tiny yellow accent strokes. Rabbit face in upper third, main scene lower two thirds, calm clear center where an HTML play button will be placed. All ears and objects fully inside the image with generous safe margins. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, play button or UI. No photographs, no invented children. Match the reference character exactly, keep the character linework crisp and understated. Scene: our rabbit is sitting by a small low round table, holding a bubble wand and watching three delicate translucent soap bubbles. A little mint bottle and two pastel building blocks on the table. Soft blush-pink and ivory background with mint touches. Delight in observing and playing, graceful composed mascot, not cartoon slapstick.
